title.narrative: Outcome 1 of the project is to improve the economic empowerment and financial inclusion of youth and women from disadvantaged areas in the Gauteng province by mitigating the problem of youth and female unemployment in the province.

title.narrative: Youth and women unemployment rates in the target areas of the project

description.narrative: Youth and women unemployment rates in the target areas of the project

comment.narrative: The unemployment rate of youth in the Gauteng province is at 47.68 in Q3 of 2022 according to the Gauteng provincial government 2023. In Q32022 there was a total number of 2.9 million young people between 1534 years old. 1.4 were unemployed. According to the Gauteng provinces SocioEconomic Review and Outlook 2022 SERO in Q3 of 2021 the female unemployment official rate in Gauteng was at 40.2.202223 female unemployment data is still not available but we expect it to be by the start of the Action.
Youth and women unemployment rates in the target areas of the project are available to set a baseline
